description: Returns a company's data center portfolio, operating and planned megawatts, interconnection queue filings, and disclosed capital commitments. Pass a company name, ticker symbol, organization ID, or project name.

company.description: Company, developer, hyperscaler, or utility name, ticker, or organization ID (e.g. 'Microsoft', 'MSFT', 'QTS Data Centers', 'Dominion Energy').

company_name.description: Company, developer, or hyperscaler name (e.g. 'Microsoft', 'QTS Data Centers', 'Vantage').

include_campuses.description: Include top campus records and capacity totals.

include_capital.description: Include disclosed capital commitments and financing events.

include_capital_stack.description: Include debt, equity, and capital stack breakdown.

include_filings.description: Include regulatory and interconnection queue filings for this company.

include_projects.description: Include the company's cataloged data center campuses and projects.

include_queue_filings.description: Include active ISO/RTO queue requests linked to this company.

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

query.description: Company name, ticker symbol, or project name (e.g. 'MSFT', 'Meta', 'QTS').
